subject.title: feat: add session stream mode command

question: Should OpenClaw adopt `/stream` as a shared persisted session command and the new `previewStreamingSessionOverride` plugin capability for supported channels?
rationale: The PR introduces a durable core command, persisted session field, and plugin API capability rather than implementing an existing documented behavior; maintainers must choose the permanent product and compatibility contract.

options.title: Adopt the shared contract
options.body: Approve the persisted `/stream` and capability design after current-head channel proof verifies the scoped delivery behavior.

options.title: Narrow the product surface
options.body: Keep the need but restrict the initial implementation to a smaller owner-channel or non-persisted design before exposing a shared plugin capability.

options.title: Decline the core feature
options.body: Leave global streaming configuration as the supported interface and direct any optional experimentation to the appropriate plugin surface.

recommendation.title: Adopt the shared contract
recommendation.body: Approve the persisted `/stream` and capability design after current-head channel proof verifies the scoped delivery behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: A history-backed owner for the command/session/channel boundary could not be established because local read-only history inspection was blocked.
